name: Clone Troll Tower
desc:
🎉 Welcome To Clone Troll Tower!
Can you survive the chaos of Clones, Trolls, Obstacles, and Slaps in this unpredictable tower?

How to Play:
🌀 Beware of fake paths, hidden traps, and sneaky clones!
👥 Spawn Clones to block enemies, troll friends, or cause total confusion!
🏆 Reach the top for Cash, an OP Slap Hand, and a Flying Carpet!
😂 Use Troll Tools to send players & friends flying into the Void!
🛒 Spend Cash on better Troll Tools and HD Admin — ✅ all purchases save forever!
🎁 Grab the Lucky Block & Void Slap at the top for exclusive rewards!
💯 Complete extra towers in the lobby to unlock an Invisibility Cloak and Ability Slap!
🏆Use Premium to Unlock Special Features!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet ✅ Your progress and purchases save automatically!

✔️ Premium Perks: The Exclusive Electric Slap to shock your rivals!

🏷️ Tags: Clone, Troll Tower, Slap, Double Jump, Parkour, Obby, Rainbow, Popular, Jump, Challenge, Cart Ride.
